intro_line: Belgrade: gritty, warm, and always awake at the confluence of two rivers.
intro: Belgrade rewards visitors with fortress views, river nightlife, and a café culture that runs late. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: City buses, trams and trolleybuses are free; express E-lines and trains are not.
Trams run 11 routes and converge around Slavija and Vukov Spomenik.
BG:Voz suburban trains link the main stations; the metro is not open yet.
Ride apps: Car:Go, Pink Taxi and Yandex Go; all need SMS verification.
Only use taxis with a roof sign and plates ending in TX; insist on the meter.
Driving is stressful at rush hour; keep low beams on and watch for police speed traps.

airports.name: Belgrade Nikola Tesla Airport
airports.note: Main gateway, about 12-18 km west of the centre.

options.to: Slavija Square via Fontana and bus station
options.note: Pay the driver in dinars or euros; runs at night with a 02:00-04:00 break.
Book by app or phone, or buy a fixed-price voucher at baggage claim.

options.mode: Ride app (Car:Go, Yandex Go, Pink Taxi)
